sentence: This project studies how to build polynomial approximations of complicated functions in spaces of analytic functions.
This project studies quantum turbulence in cold atoms and how it connects to classical turbulence and neutron stars.
This project uses deep learning and street view images to map encampments of unhoused persons and study their migration patterns.
This project measures proteins and reactive oxygen-containing molecules in cells of an amoeba to understand how they interact.
This project digitizes temperature, pressure and winds recorded in merchant ship logbooks to fill gaps in Antarctic weather data.
This project studies how a protein gradient that maintains stem cells stays robust in the shoot apical meristem of plants.
This project redesigns a college cybersecurity and systems administration program and adds hands-on training tools, including a cyber range.
This project studies how free-roaming bison affect plants and forage in montane fescue grasslands after reintroduction.
This project builds computational methods that find biological functions in single cell multi-omics data.
This project builds an associate degree program and certificate programs on electric vehicle technology, connected automated vehicles and cybersecurity.
This project studies the chemical reactions of organic peroxy radicals in cloud droplets and fine particles.
This project studies the chemical composition of pyrogenic organic matter from wildfires, how it breaks down, and when it is released from watersheds.
This project builds computational tools that use machine learning and quantum computing to study fluid-structure interactions.
This project expands an open-source software platform to simulate the quantum behavior of electrons and nuclei in time-resolved spectroscopy.
This project tests whether neural crest cells migrate into the zebrafish forebrain and directly help build it.
This project studies how the mode of reproduction shapes the evolution of mutation rates in a snail, a ciliate and plants.
This project studies how biomolecular condensates and cell growth affect each other, using engineered gene circuits and computational modeling.
